findings.description: Submitting the add (or edit) form with a value the server rejects (e.g. a whitespace-only title, or an amount with more than 2 decimals such as 1.999 or 1e3 sent without browser validation) returns HTTP 400 and re-renders the form with every field cleared and no error message, so the user gets no explanation and loses what they typed.
repro: Observe a blank form, no error message, entered data lost (server answered 400)

notes: Checked: total equals sum of rows (all, filtered, after add/edit/delete), category filter, add flow with flash and persistence after reload, edit flow with immediate list/total update, viewer 403 on direct GET/POST edit/add/delete and no controls, XSS escaping, login errors. No other defects found. Amount/title length have no upper bound (not reported).

cost.notes: estimate from 30587 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0061-$0.0734
